name: Auralyn Discord Music Bot
author: admin@example.com
description: Hyperscale-ready Auralyn Discord music bot with automatic sharding support. Runs the bot and bundled Lavalink server in one Docker container. Supports up to 2500+ guilds per shard with health monitoring, graceful shutdown, and per-shard memory tracking.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
echo "Auralyn uses a prebuilt bundled Docker image. No source install is required."

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: The Discord bot token. Keep this private and rotate it immediately if exposed.

variables.name: Discord Client ID
variables.description: The Discord application client ID used for slash command registration.

variables.name: Guild ID
variables.description: Optional development guild ID for fast slash command deployment. Leave empty for global commands.

variables.name: Lavalink Password
variables.description: Shared password between the bot and the bundled Lavalink server. Use a long random value.

variables.name: Lavalink Memory
variables.description: Maximum heap for Lavalink, for example 512M, 1G, or 2G.

variables.name: Lavalink Startup Timeout
variables.description: Seconds to wait for Lavalink to become healthy before failing startup.

variables.name: Spotify Client ID
variables.description: Optional Spotify client ID for LavaSrc.

variables.name: Spotify Client Secret
variables.description: Optional Spotify client secret for LavaSrc. Keep private.

variables.name: Total Shards
variables.description: Number of shards for hyperscale. Set to 'auto' for automatic detection, or specify an integer (e.g., 4, 8, 16).

variables.name: Shard Spawn Delay (ms)
variables.description: Delay between shard spawns in milliseconds. Default 5500ms respects Discord identify rate limit.

variables.name: Shard Spawn Timeout (ms)
variables.description: Timeout for each shard startup in milliseconds.

variables.name: Shard Health Check Interval (ms)
variables.description: How often to check shard health and memory usage.

variables.name: Shard Max Memory (MB)
variables.description: Memory threshold per shard before logging warning.

variables.name: Graceful Shutdown Timeout (ms)
variables.description: Time to wait for graceful shutdown before force-killing shards.

variables.name: Shard Status Interval (ms)
variables.description: Optional: Print shard status every N milliseconds. Leave empty to disable.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, or error.
